authoredNote: Transcribed from a measured run against this file (the dump is reproduced in validation/m14/fixtures/php/local-read-phantom.mts, which asserts the same edges by rule rather than by list). The READING half of the two-file local-read fixture; `declares.expectation.json` is the other half.
rationale: THE PIN IS THE SPELLING. Every `uses` edge here is a BARE `$variable` read — a parameter, a foreach value, an accumulator — and a local binding is never a published symbol, so the string the edge writes is the only thing that says which binding it read. Under the bare-name rule that string was `counter`, and `declares.php` declares a `counter` property on an unrelated class in another file: measured against the gate's own rule (`classifyEdge`), the bare spelling classifies `resolved (decls=1, kinds=property)` and binds `run`'s own local to `Telemetry::$counter`. The fix spells a binding as `<read source>\u0000<binding>` with `metadata.localBinding` (`BINDING_SEP`, `src/ast/types.ts:190`), which no published key can carry, so both lookup strategies miss it and the row is stored unresolved instead of mis-bound. The `forbidRelationships` rows below are what makes that a test rather than a description: the bare spelling must not come back.
